title: Riemannian Structures on Quotients in Elastic Diffeology via Q-Charts
summary: Following Miyamoto, we consider Q-charts, a class of subductions $φ\colon X\to Y$ of diffeological spaces along which Blohmann's elasticity descends. We show that the Riemannian apparatus of elastic diffeology---vertical, horizontal and full connections, Riemannian metrics, Levi-Civita connections and geodesics---also descends along Q-charts.
